content.comment_body: When using the [product_name] Web Editor, I've mostly worked with blocks that have a single parameter, like basic inputs and outputs. Now I'm exploring the seven-day time switch block, which includes parameters for each day of the week, on/off times, and others. I'm looking for guidance on how to map these multiple parameters between the [product_name] Web Editor and [product_name] programming software.
Check the Parameter-VM-Mapping feature found in the tools section of the [product_name] programming software.
Hello, I will read the information. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is seeking advice on how to connect several scheduling parameters from a seven-day switch block between two [product_name] software tools. The complexity of these parameters makes it less straightforward than with simpler input/output blocks. Another community member points out a built-in tool that can help with parameter mapping.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for an easy, well-documented process or intuitive in-software feature to support mapping of schedule-related settings between different [product_name] tools.
